objective.statement: Cursor zsh -c cache hits must not re-export DIRENV_DIFF or DIRENV_WATCHES.
objective.measure: node --test scripts/test-stable-shell-path.mjs and a sanitized zsh -c in jcode leave those variables unset.

need.statement: Dump caches store direnv's one-line export, including DIRENV_DIFF, so every sanitized spawn re-poisons ARG_MAX.
need.baseline: 2026-08-21 measurement: 504/504 dumps contain DIRENV_DIFF; max dump 142639 bytes; sanitized zsh -c DIFF_LEN=10400.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Child execs hit E2BIG and fork-storm.
assumptions: direnv export bash emits a single semicolon-joined line using $'' quoting.
alternatives_considered: Force Cursor to use agent-shell argv0
Unset only after source when length exceeds 64KiB

purpose: Stop dump-cache hits from re-exporting direnv snapshots that blow ARG_MAX.
consumer: Cursor zsh -c, Claude/Codex BASH_ENV, and the host agent-shell wrapper.
contract: A fill of the agent-direnv dump cache writes a snapshot with DIRENV_DIFF and DIRENV_WATCHES removed, records the envrc root, and refuses a dump whose recorded root no longer has .envrc.
failure_boundary: A failed strip leaves the dump unpublished rather than caching a poisoned snapshot. The post-source 64KiB unset remains as defense in depth.

evidence.description: scripts/test-stable-shell-path.mjs asserts dump strip, sourced env, and dead-root refusal.

falsifier.claim: A sanitized zsh -c in /home/mhugo/code/jcode still has DIRENV_DIFF longer than 65536 after the loader, or still invokes direnv export on a warm cache hit.

executable_check.description: Focused Node contract plus live zsh -c

non_goals: Home Manager switch unless the wrapper module changes
invariants: Nested shells with a matching DIRENV_DIR still skip
Cache hits do not run direnv allow or export

assumptions.statement: python3 is on PATH for agent shells that fill the cache.
assumptions.falsifier: A fill with python3 missing caches an unstripped dump.

plane_constraints: Edits stay in ~/.dotfiles shell/bash and scripts/test-stable-shell-path.mjs.
The sourced .sh is live without Home Manager switch.
